title: CatalyticMLLM: A Graph-Text Multimodal Large Language Model for Catalytic Materials
abstract: arXiv:2605.17254v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Property prediction and inverse structural design of catalytic materials are typically modeled as two independent tasks: the former predicts target properties from given structures, whereas the latter generates candidate structures conditioned on desired properties. Although this decoupled paradigm facilitates the construction of a ``generation--evaluation--screening'' workflow, the two models may have different domains of applicability because they are trained on different data distributions. translated_title: CatalyticMLLM：面向催化材料的图-文本多模态大语言模型
translated_abstract: 催化材料的性质预测与逆向结构设计通常被建模为两个独立的任务：前者从给定结构预测目标性质，后者根据期望性质生成候选结构。尽管这种解耦范式便于构建“生成—评估—筛选”的工作流程，但由于两个模型在不同的数据分布上训练，它们的适用域可能不同。因此，在闭环优化过程中，生成模型可能产生超出评估模型可靠适用域的结构，而评估模型的预测误差会在 successive 迭代中不断累积，最终导致逆向设计性能下降。在本工作中，我们提出了CatalyticMLLM，这是一个面向催化材料的统一图-文本多模态大语言模型，它整合了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CatalyticMLLM，一个统一的图-文本多模态大语言模型，将催化材料的性质预测与逆向结构设计整合到单一模型中，避免了传统解耦范式因适用域不匹配与误差累积而导致的逆向设计性能下降问题。
en_tdlr: CatalyticMLLM is a unified graph-text multimodal large language model that integrates catalytic material property prediction and inverse structural design into a single model, overcoming the applicability domain mismatch and error accumulation issues of the traditional decoupled "generation-evaluation-screening" paradigm.
